Commentary.Commentary: The Windies have around 30 minutes to bat till Lunch. The least they can hope is to try and see off this period without losing a wicket. The players are back out to the middle. Kraigg Brathwaite and Kieran Powell come to bat for the second time in 2 days. The skipper will take strike to Mohammed Shami. Here we go...

What to talk about the Windies? Seemed clueless with the bat. Chase showed how to bat on this wicket while Paul was brilliant in his first innings in India. Sunil Ambris showed a bit of promise but he needs to be patient as well. The rest were simply poor.

The bowling was accurate and pinpoint. Exactly how a dominant team should bowl. Shami strutted his stuff with swing and reverse while Ashwin and Jadeja did their bit with spin. Umesh Yadav was disappointing yesterday but he made up for it this morning. Kuldeep Yadav though, was a big disappointment. He was being attacked but he did not vary his pace at all and even struggled to land the ball on a consistent length.
The innings has been done and dusted in 48 overs. Apart from the Chase-Paul stand this morning, India have simply not had to break any sweat. The most bowlers bowled were 11 by Umesh and Ashwin each.

OUT! Easily stumped. The carrom ball becomes the undoing of Gabriel after playing out almost the whole over watchfully. The ball is tossed up outside off and Shannon is drawn forward to defend. He misses the line comprehensively and almost as a reflex action, his feet come out of the crease. He tries to get his left foot back but by that time Pant has whipped off the bails. It always looked out to the naked eye but Ian Gould at square leg did not want to take any chances. INDIA LEAD BY 468 AND HAVE ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON.
Is that stumped? Gabriel looks to be a goner but umpire Ian Gould just wants to be sure. referred upstairs...
Full and outside off, Gabriel gets a good stride forward and blocks.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, Gabriel comes forward and watchfully defends.

LUCKY. Full and outside off, Gabriel cannot control any longer. He looks to slog but gets a top edge. Luckily for him, the ball lands in between cover and point. Bishoo wants two but Gabriel lazily puts his hand up after the single. The former is not at all happy. All the best against Ashwin now.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and off, chipped down to long on for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full and down the leg side, Bishoo looks to sweep but gets a top edge which lobs over square leg. Just about manages to reach the ropes.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Down the leg side, fired away, Devendra missed his flick but the ball goes off his pads down the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! SMASH! Full and outside off, Bishoo gets down and mows it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Moves to 12 with his second boundary.
Around off, defended from the crease this time.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Interesting. Gabriel survives with a forward defense.
Pushes this towards mid on for a single, leaving Gabriel to survive one ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Pant is having a nightmare behind the stumps in this Test. Full and outside off, Bishoo looks to defend, but gets a thick outside edge. Pant is late to get up and the ball deflects off his gloves past Ajinkya Rahane at first slip. Two runs taken.
FOUR! STUPENDOUS! Full and outside off, Bishoo gets down and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Ravindra Jadeja is given an opportunity as well.

FOUR BYES! You will not die wondering. Full and outside off, Gabriel swings wildly, is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and misses. The ball misses the stumps and beats the keeper to the fine leg fence. Everyone is smiling after that shot. Reminds us of the days when Muttiah Muralidaran used to bat.
Shannon Gabriel walks in at number 11. He is slowly trudging out, with a smile...

OUT! That is a beauty and Ashwin has his third. After bowling two offies, setting the tail-ender up, he bowls a carrom ball. Too good for Lewis. He looks to defend but is squared up and the ball hits the off stump.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
DRINKS BREAK. Sherman Lewis is out in the middle.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! beautiful bowling. Full and outside off, a touch wide, enticing the batsman to drive. Chase obliges, reaches out but then the ball spins in, takes the inside edge and hits the stumps. A watchful knock comes to an end.
Full and outside off, pushed towards the bowler.
Full and around off, Bishoo looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge towards the leg side.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and straight, watchfully blocked.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.

EDGED, BUT DROPPED! A touch short outside off, Chase goes back to cut. Gets an outside edge but Rishabh Pant behind is unable to adjust to the bounce. Gets hit on the glove and the ball lobs in the air, but wide of Rahane at first slip. Pant rushes across to his right, puts in a dive but in vain.
Goes back in his crease and blocks it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Ravichandran Ashwin time. Not surprising. Kuldeep has been expensive this morning, going for 43 in his 6.
Full on middle, Devendra looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, a touch wide, stays low, left alone.
On a length, around off, Bishoo looks to defend but the ball moves away to beat him.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.

FOUR! 6th Test Fifty for Chase! A calm knock under pressure by Roston. His team is in dire straits but he has not been absorbed by it. Full and outside off, Chase leans and drives it down the ground. Long on is in place but he has no chance.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
FOUR! BEAUTY! Full and outside off, Chase reaches out and drives it through the covers for a boundary! Moves to within a hit of a half century. Will he get there?
A bouncer on middle, Bishoo ducks.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Devendra Bishoo walks in. He is known to hang around for a while...

OUT! Umesh has broken through! The dangerous Paul is dismissed, just 3 short of his maiden Test fifty. End of a wonderful knock. The bowler is also sensing it as for the first time in 7 wickets, we have seen someone celebrating or roaring. Clearly India were getting frustrated and are pumped up now. A short ball outside off, Paul instantly looks to pull. But the pace of Umesh does him in. He is not able to time his shot properly and the ball gently lobs towards mid-wicket. Cheteshwar Pujara comes running a few paces and takes a good catch. This is one thing which Shami missed this morning. He kept bowling full, full and full, searching for swing while Umesh has tried all sorts of things, eventually getting rewarded. As they say, change is the essence of life and Shami did not change his length much.

FOUR! Another one off the outside edge. Full and outside off, Paul comes forward and looks to defend, but with soft hands. The ball takes the edge but the ball goes onto the ground and escapes the man at gully. All the way to the third man fence. The stand is worth 73 now, from 80 balls.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around middle, defended back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched straight to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

SIX! SLAUGHTERED! Paul is putting on a show here. The leg spinner again, pitched up, outside off, Paul gets down and launches into it. Slog sweeps it over mid-wicket and the ball sails over the ropes. Moves to 43 from 45 deliveries in a stand of 68. Wow.
Short and outside off, pushed towards cover.
On middle and leg, tucked to the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, Chase pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, Keemo gets across to defend but a thick inside edge is induced onto his pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
What a ball. On a length just outside off, Paul looks to defend but then the ball moves away, just past the outside edge.
Goes back and blocks it from his crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good start. Full and just around off, Paul gets across and pushes it to the off side.
Umesh Yadav gas been brought into the attack here. 7-1-14-0 so far.

FOUR! Kuldeep is being taken to the cleaners here. Full and around middle, Chase comes forward and lofts it as clean as a whistle over mid-wicket for a boundary! Kuldeep has gone for  26 in his 4 overs this morning.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! SLAP! First shot in anger from Chase this morning. Full and outside off, Roston gets down and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary!
Full and outside off, Chase looks to defend but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards mid off.
Another forward defense to end the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.

FOUR! A bit streaky but it is a boundary to raise the 50-run stand in just 55 balls. On a length outside off, Paul gets squared up a touch as he looks to defend. After facing two incoming deliveries, this one moved away and hence the squaring up. But the outside edge dies down and runs wide of gully to the third man fence.
A length ball, on middle, Paul gets across, looks to tuck but misses. Shami puts in an LBW appeal but it is turned down immediately. Possibly an inside edge.
Tailing in, around middle and leg, watchfully defended.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Full and outside off, almost a yorker, pushed back to the bowler.
Looks to swing this to the leg side but gets beaten by the spin. The ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket. A single taken and this partnership is worth 49 now.
FOUR! AWESOME! Terrific batting. Plenty of width outside off, pretty full, Paul uses his range, gets to the pitch of the ball with a lunge and drives it powerfully past a diving cover for a boundary!
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a single.
Excellent delivery. Full and straight, Keemo keeps it out.

FOUR BYES! Shami struggles to control the swing on this occasion. Bowls it way down the leg side and even though Paul cannot connect his attempted flick, it is too wide for the diving Pant as the ball races to his left to the fine leg fence.

EDGED, FOUR! Interesting tactic from Paul. He has noticed that the ball is reversing and is trying to counter it by walking down the pitch. He does so here, but Shami bowls it wide outside off. Pretty full, the drive is attempted again and this time the outside edge is induced. But it goes wide of gully to the third man fence.
And again. The drive, the swing and then the miss.
Full and outside off, Paul reaches out to drive but misses.

DIRECT HIT WOULD HAVE HAD PAUL! Kuldeep has his hands on his head. That would have been the second run out of the innings. Full and outside off, Chase pushes it to the off side and then calls his partner through. Paul responds but is a bit late to take off. Kuldeep Yadav gets across to his left from cover, collects the ball, takes aim and then has a shy at the striker's end with Keemo not even halfway down the pitch. Misses.
Floated outside off, Paul lunges and blocks.
A long hop, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and around off, there comes the sweep - towards deep square leg for a single.

NEARLY A CHANCE! That would have been a weird dismissal. Short and outside off, Paul goes back and looks to cut. But the ball spins back in sharply and cramps him for room. He is hit on the right glove and the ball lobs in the air. Prithvi Shaw dives to his left at short leg but cannot get there.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Going for the reverse, gets the ball moving but it is a full toss on middle which Roston pushes it towards silly mid on.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and wide outside off, Chase reaches out and drives it wide of mid off for a couple.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! 10 runs from the opening over of the day! Full and around off, Paul gets down and clobbers the sweep past Prithvi Shaw at short leg. There is a man at long leg but before he can run 5 paces, the ball is past him to the square leg boundary!
Floated outside off, KP looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. Short leg thinks he has a chance but the ball drops down in front of him.

LUCKY! Keemo looks to go through the off side again, aiming to force it off his back foot but the ball spins in, sticks off the pitch, takes the inside edge and misses the stumps and goes to Virat Kohli at leg slip!
A tad short again, Keemo goes back and punches it through point for a brace. All three balls have seen attacking shots so far.
FOUR! Fuller and around off, Paul gets down and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.

Nice to see Kohli smiling. He is with his teammates in a huddle and seems to be giving some instructions. Now, the players disperse. Out walk Roston Chase and Keemo Paul. Kuldeep Yadav will begin proceedings for the day. Paul to face. Here we go!

After a totally one-sided matchup prior to the weekend, will Saturday prove any different? The Windies have simply not turned up either with the bat or ball and India look all set to get a massive lead. The question is - will Kohli enforce the follow-on if the lower order bats for more than an hour? On the other side, can the tourists frustrate the hosts with some resilience? Hello and a warm welcome to the third day of the opening Test between India and Windies in Rajkot.
... DAY 3, MORNING SESSION ...

Alright then! This match has developed pace in a frenetic manner. The Indian bowlers will be looking to come back fresh on Saturday morning and try and get the remaining 4 wickets in the first hour. And then, probably enforce the follow-on and give us an off on Sunday. Join us at 0930 local (0400 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Ravindra Jadeja is now giving an interview to Sanjay Manjrekar. The all-rounder says that he is happy on getting a ton after 9 years in international cricket. Details that in the past, he used to get out in the 70s and 80s, thinking about the century. But today, he finally managed to get past that mental hurdle. Admits that he too, is surprised and disappointed that he has never got a hundred and is very happy that he eventually got one, which he will remember for a long time. On being reminded about his 80-odd against England recently, he says that in that inning, Anderson and Broad were bowling really well and the conditions were overcast as well, which means not much was there in the batsmen's favour. Hence, he was only thinking about scoring runs. First 50, then move on from there and keep going. Talking about being given opportunities, he remembers that he was given a chance after 15 months, where he spent time away from ODI cricket. (The topic has diverted to Asia Cup by the way). Admits that he felt the pressure to perform - but to himself, not for others. Further  says that he is enjoying his cricket. On being asked about his affected run out today, he explains that when he saw both Hetmyer and Ambris at one end, he thought that there is no need to hurry and hence he was walking towards the stumps. But suddenly, he saw Hetmyer running and had a shy. Is embarrassed about what would have happened had he missed and considers himself lucky that his shy found the mark.

Is this Indian attack the best in the world? No Bhuvi. No Bumrah. No Ishant. Yet they have piled on the pressure on the opposition. Agreed, the Windies are not that technically sound but this is a terrific team bowling effort. First, you need to see the new-ball bowlers off in Shami or Bumrah or Bhuvi. Then, you encounter the spin of Ashwin or Jadeja or Kuldeep. The main bowlers did well in England. And here, the bench has strutted its stuff.

The opening batsmen were clueless against the guile of Shami while the middle order was consumed by spin. Then of course, some generosity was produced as well in a run out and a wild shot. Overall, nothing much to describe in the tourists' batting, except for Roston Chase, who has shown the gumption to survive.

A forgettable couple of days for the visiting side. First, they were pummeled mercilessly with the bat and then, have been almost skittled out in not even half the time. The players look fagged out under the heat and have simply not turned up.
The reverse on offer again. Full on off, coming in a long way, Chase just about keeps it out towards mid-wicket. STUMPS ON DAY 2, WINDIES TRAIL BY 555!
On a length around middle, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot. The fielding side are asking the question. The umpire decides the batsman is not out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
Full and straight, driven straight back to the bowler.
Oopss... Full and outside off, Chase reaches out and looks to defend but gets a bottom edge which just misses the stumps!
Mohammed Shami to bowl the final over of the day.
Pitched outside leg, KP pads it away.
The batsman gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side.
The googly, outside off, Keemo goes for the wild slog but misses.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Full and around off, Paul gets down on a knee and sweeps it powerfully through square leg for a boundary!
SIX! SLAM! Full and outside off, Paul comes down the track and sends the ball over long on! Does not matter to Paul even if there are just 2 overs to the close.
FOUR! A bit of reverse coming in and Shami gets too greedy. Bowls a length ball on the pads and is flicked towards square leg.
The batsman comes down the track and does well to get his body behind the ball. The fielding side is asking the question. One run added to the total. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
On middle and leg, played towards mid-wicket.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Mohmmed Shami is back on.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Now Paul goes for the heave and mistimes it over mid on. Lokesh Rahul runs back and tries to take it but he cannot get there either. Just about stops it before the ball touches the ropes. A couple taken.

INSIDE EDGE, NOT TAKEN! Full and around middle, Paul looks to defend but the ball goes off the glove, takes the pads and then lobs in the air. Prithvi Shaw runs back from short leg but cannot quite get there.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Into the bowlers now. Keemo Paul is the first of them.

OUT! Right through! Kuldeep is amongst the wickets as well. Tossed up around off and outside, Dowrich looks to push it through the off side but is done in by the flight and pace. He misses and the ball spins right in, hitting the timber. This is similar to the way Kuldeep dismissed Peter Handscomb from Australia in the Dharamsala Test.
Full and around leg, Dowrich looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Full nd outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR BYES! Full and down the leg side, Dowrich looks to paddle but misses. Pant is blinded behind and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Issue with the ball. Kuldeep shows it to the umpire and Kohli comes across, a bit concerned. Umpire Nigel Llong puts it through the 8-shaped guage and it passes through. So the ball is given back to the bowler. Nothing wrong with the shape.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! A wild slog. Full and outside off, Chase gets down and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary. That was not from the middle of the bat.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, played towards point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Landed outside off, defended back.
Full and around off, Dowrich comes forward to defend but the ball lands, spins away, takes the outside edge and goes wide of slip. A single.
Full and outside off, driven towards the bowler.
Tossed up a bit, blocked back to the bowler.
On middle and off, RC reaches out and works it towards mid-wicket.
Pitched outside leg, Roston lunges and drops the ball down in front of short leg.
A touch short, worked towards square leg.
Great effort. Full and outside off, Chase drives it through the covers but Ashwin dives full stretch to his right and makes a clean stop.
Kuldeep Yadav into the attack now.
Full and straight, watchfully patted back. A maiden over from Jadeja, India's 4th in this innings.
Full and around off, driven towards mid off.
A touch short, punched towards cover.
Outside off, Chase drives it towards silly point where Prithvi Shaw tries to get out of harm's way but is hit on the right shin. That would have hurt.
Arrows it on middle, Chase drives it inside out wide of cover for a single.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Chase uses his big reach and defends.
On middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely timed. Full and outside off, Chase jumps out and hits this straight back over the bowler for a boundary down the ground. The stand moves to 12 now.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! A rare bad ball. Short and outside off, Dowrich goes back and cuts it between cover and point to find the fence.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
On middle and leg, worked to the leg side.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
A touch short outside off, punched towards cover.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched towards cover for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Full and just outside off, Dowrich comes forward and blocks.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Full and outside off, Chase lunges to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge, wide of slip. A single towards third man.
Outside off, let through.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs. 50 UP FOR THE WINDIES! An achievement.
Tossed up outside off, Dowrich plays that a bit uppishly but it does not carry to cover.
Full on middle, driven straight back to the bowler.
Shane Dowrich walks in at number 7, replacing Ambris.

OUT! Strikes first ball! The magic of 'Sir' on display straightaway. Full and outside off, Ambris looks to drive it forcefully through the off side but he is not quite to the pitch of the ball. It spins away, takes the outside edge and Ajinkya Rahane at first slip takes a sharp catch. From Ambris' point of view, well, his policy might have been to attack Jadeja from the word go. But he could have waited a couple of balls and then tried his ploy. Half the side is back in just 16 overs.
Here comes 'Sir' Ravindra Jadeja.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
On middle, flicked away for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Excellent timing! On middle, Roston works it through mid-wicket. Kuldeep Yadav gives it a good chase and just about stops the ball. Three runs taken as Yadav slips.
FOUR! PUMMELED! Full and outside off, Chase comes down the track and swipes it over mid-wicket. The ball just bounces in front of the ropes.
Comes down the track and works it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
A length ball wide outside off, Sunil chases after it and nearly edges it behind. The ball moves further away after pitching.
On middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Umesh Yadav gets a warning, meanwhile, for running on the danger area. Not official, just a friendly advice.

Full on middle, Ambris flicks it uppishly and it almost carries towards Prithvi Shaw at square leg! That is a very rare position in Test cricket. Seems like Kohli has studied Ambris well in whatever little time he has spent at the crease.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Good news for India. Mohammed Shami is back on the field.

DRINKS BREAK. Terrorizing passage of play for the visiting side. They were not able to get much wickets when India were batting and now, they are not able to get any runs. They are not even close to face pace or spin. With 15 overs left in the day, all they can hope now is to try and see those out without any more damage. All the best.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and around off, Roston looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge, just wide of short leg!
Full and outside off, well defended.
EDGED, WIDE! Full and outside off, Roston lunges to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge, just wide of a diving Ajinkya Rahane at first slip! Two runs taken.

FOUR BYES! That has missed everyone and everything. Full and outside off, Chase stays back to defend but the ball snakes off the pitch, beats the outside edge, misses the pad and then goes over the stumps, missing the keeper as well, enroute the fine leg fence.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Another one on the pads, SA misses his flick again.
Down the leg side, Sunil misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but that was going down the leg side.
Slips this down the leg side, flick shot missed.
On middle and leg, worked to the leg side.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle, flicked uppishly, but just wide of short mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Roston Chase walks in at number 6, replacing Hetmyer.

OUT! Confusion everywhere! Oh dear... a comedy of errors. First, a short ball. Hetmyer works it towards the leg side and initially sets off. Ambris responds but then Hetmyer changes his mind. Both batsmen are within handshaking distance of each other and then go back into the batting crease. Now, Ambris is frustrated and plonks his bat at the striker's end. Amidst all this, Jadeja has still not released the throw. Seeing that, Hetmyer starts to run. Jadeja still does not throw and Ashwin has already walked away from the stumps. At the last moment, Jaddu throws and luckily for him, it hits the stumps! He smiles but Kohli is not amused.
Lucky escape. Full and on middle, Hetmyer comes down the track and looks to go over the top but mistimes it over mid-wicket. Jadeja hares after it from mid on and keeps the batsmen to a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single. Ambris has actually got what he wished. His couple of shots through and over the infield in Ashwin's previous over have resulted in Kohli spreading the field. Strange.
On a length outside off, let through.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Outside off, Hetmyer plays inside the line and is beaten.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

FOUR! A bit of a miscue this time. Ashwin will not mind. He gives this a bit more air and Ambris is out of his crease again. This time though, he is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Still, he goes through with his lofted shot and clears mid-wicket. A couple of bounces into the fence.
Outside off, a touch wide. Sunil reaches out to block but misses.
FOUR! AMAZING! What a shot to play on the second ball that you face. Full and outside off, Ambris comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it wide of mid off to find the fence.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Sunil Ambris walks in now.

OUT! BOWLED! For a second, we felt that it was a play and a miss. It is indeed a play and a miss but the ball has missed the bat and hit the stump. Ashwin amongst the wickets now. Full and outside off, Hope comes half forward to defend but misses. The ball goes past the bat, misses his back pad as he looks to cover the line and then clips the bail over the off stump. Superb.
On middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, punched through the off side.

Full, very full, almost a yorker, Hetmyer pushes it back past the bowler. Takes Ashwin on at mid off and gets a quick single. There is a shy at the bowler's end and it is a direct hit but the batsman is well in.
Stays back in his crease and punches it back to the bowler.
Around off, going away, Hetmyer feels for that but gets beaten.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Around off, watchfully blocked out.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flicks it away for a single.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Close call! Short and outside off, Hope looks to cut but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Down the leg side, flicked away for a single.
Mohammed Shami is going off the field. Seems to be an issue with his hamstring. Spin is in. Here is Ravichandran Ashwin.
FOUR! Fine shot again. Full and straight, Hope sends it right back to where it came from.
Full on middle, driven towards mid on.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A length ball outside off, Hope looks to cut but gets a bottom edge behind, towards the slip cordon.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, driven straight back.
Full on middle, driven straight back.
Outside off, Shimron plays inside the line of that and is beaten.
FOUR! EDGED away! No one to catch that. Why? On a length outside off, Hetmyer slashes hard and gets a thick outside edge which flies past gully to third man.
On a length outside off, Hetmyer plays inside the line and is beaten.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Hope lets it through.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bouncer, Shimron ducks.
Who is next to face the Shami music? Shimron Hetmyer comes the reply from one of my colleagues. Can he get Windies out of this mire?

OUT! One brings another and now Shami has two! The around the wicket angle has done the trick for the bowling side. Shami comes charging in and Powell, shuffles across his sticks. He misses his flick and is hit flush in front. Shami appeals and up goes Ian Gould's finger! Powell is ready to go back but then Hope calls him back and they decide to go for the review. Bad, bad call. Not from the umpire. But by the batsmen. Hit in line, going to hit the stumps.
Powell has been adjudged LBW! But he wants another look at it. Looks dead plumb.
Outside off, punched to the off side.
FOUR! SWEET! What a shot. Probably the best of the day. Full and around off, Hope drives it straight back. Bisects mid off and mid on perfectly and finds the fence. First boundary of the innings.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad.
On middle and leg, Powell works it towards mid-wicket where Prithvi Shaw fumbles and allows the southpaw to get off strike and off the mark.
Stays deep in his crease and defends. A terrific wicket maiden from Shami.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Outside off, an easier leave this time as the ball is a touch wide.
Another cracker. Shami is getting into his groove. The ball lands on a length outside off, Hope is leaving it but then that nut comes back in a long way. Just about misses the sticks.
Shai Hope comes in at number 3, replacing his skipper.

OUT! The delivery is deemed legal and the Windies captain has to depart. Replays seemed touch and go and it felt as if the foot landed on the line. However... anyways. That takes nothing away from the delivery. This is the Shami we all know about. Not the one who bowled the first over. He lands this on a good length outside off and skids it on. Brathwaite is not sure - whether to play from the crease or go forward. Whether the ball will move in or move out. Eventually, he decides to play back, as the ball comes in. But he is late. The cherry shoots onto his pads, misses the bat and knocks the off stump out of the ground. What a sight for any fast bowler. Brathwaite is asked to wait and as the replays are shown, Kohli is seen nervous. On the line? Anything behind? Something behind, according to the one sitting upstairs. That's what matters.
Bowled! Neck and crop! But has Shami overstepped? They are checking...
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, Powell looks to defend but gets squared up and an outside edge is induced. Goes all along the ground.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A touch fuller, outside off, Powell drives it through the covers but it is stopped with a dive.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Another one down the leg side, flicked away for a single.
He too, starts with a delivery down the leg side, Brathwaite misses his flick.
Umesh Yadav to bowl from the other end.
Brathwaite is away. Windies are away. Full and down the leg side, the skipper flicks it towards fine leg and gets off the mark. A rusty over from Shami - all over the place. Sprayed it everywhere.
On middle and leg, played towards short mid-wicket.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Full on middle and off, now that is something which Brathwaite has missed out. Flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, moving away, left alone. That was a touch wide.
A length ball around off, Brathwaite looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the thigh pads.
